subject: Security qualification: records, retention, and evidence playbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security qualification: records, retention, and evidence playbook

Thanks again for taking the demo and the security deep-dive this afternoon. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Key pain points you raised
- Audit log retention: need 7 years of immutable audit logs for certain workflows (payments reconciliation, suspicious activity).
- SOC 2 evidence: need a short path to provide system configuration, access logs, change-control artifacts for our auditors.
- DPA language and data residency: legal needs specific wording around subprocessor list and retention windows.
- Pen test: you prefer a vendor-managed window tied to release cadence (quarterly preferred).

Goals we discussed
1) Provide an evidence bundle that maps directly to your SOC 2 control families (CC1–CC7) and specifically highlights how audit logs and retention are realized.
2) Show exportability of audit logs and a sample export.
3) Agree on a timeline for pen test windows and DPA edits so your procurement can hit the end-of-quarter target.

Immediate next steps (owners + ETA)
- Marcus to share a concise evidence checklist and sample artifacts (today EOD) — Marcus Lin
- IR to provide a short DPA redline template and subprocessor list (Mon 7/30) — Irene Choi
- Jordan to coordinate a 30-min follow-up with Tom and Olivia to validate artifact format (Tue 7/31) — Jordan Blake
- FiscalPay to confirm preferred pen-test window and vendor constraints (by Mon 7/31) — Olivia/Tom

Attachments referenced: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (artifact index), pen-test-scope.pdf (recommended scope), auditlog-sample-export.txt (sample). I uploaded these to the shared Drive link below.

If anything above is incorrect or missing, flag it and I'll update. Otherwise, I'll set the follow-up for 7/31 and Marcus will drop the artifact bundle in the Drive folder.

Best,
Irene Choi

Subject: Re: Security qualification: records, retention, and evidence playbook

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Retention: the 7-year requirement applies only to transaction audit trails for regulated customers; operational logs we can archive at 1 year with searchable indices for 7 years. Can you call that out in the evidence mapping?
- Export format: our auditors prefer CSV for event exports but we can accept gzipped JSON if metadata is preserved. Will the sample export include schema docs?
- Pen test: we have an approved vendor list (see attached) and we need the testing window to be at least 5 business days with pre-test scoping. Are you able to grant short-lived access tokens for the vendor?

Also, procurement asked whether you have a standard DPA redline that lists your subprocessor commitments and whether retention controls are acceptable as an addendum.

I pulled a few people into this thread: Tom (ops) will own pen-test logistics, and our security contact uses sec@fiscalpay.com for artifact intake. We aim to complete vendor and DPA reviews by 8/12 so the contract can be live 8/20.

Hi Olivia, Tom — quick technical addendum with specifics requested. Posting the artifact list below and noting what we can provide immediately versus what requires a short runbook.

Immediate artifacts (available now)
- Audit log schema and sample exports: auditlog-sample-export.txt (we can provide CSV or gzipped JSON; sample includes field-level descriptions)
- Access-control manifest: list of IAM roles, last 90-day access events (redacted)
- Change control records: PR/CD pipeline snapshots and deployment approvals for the last 12 months
- Encryption key management note: KMS provider + rotation cadence

Next-steps artifacts (2–5 business days to assemble)
- SOC 2 mapping: control-by-control artifact mapping (deliverable: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx)
- Retention policy addendum language and counts export (to show retention sweep processes)
- Pen-test gating instructions: short-lived vendor tokens and IP allowlist template (requires legal sign-off for token scopes)

On the pen-test window: we can support a 5 business-day testing window. We typically provide vendor access via a temporary service account tied to the engagement that expires at the end of the window. We will also provide an ingress IP allowlist and a scoped set of endpoints. If FiscalPay's vendor needs deeper network access, we’ll coordinate an exception plan.

Regarding DPA redlines: we have a standard DPA template and a redline we can share. Irene will send the initial redline; legal is usually comfortable adding a retention addendum if the technical controls are demonstrated.

Links and attachments:
- Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bEvidenceBundle
- Pen-test vendor template: https://drive.google.com/file/d/pen-test-template

Attachments included: pen-test-scope.pdf, auditlog-sample-export.txt, redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (draft)

Let me know if you want the CSV export rather than JSON; I can generate a CSV with the required fields and upload it to the Drive folder.

Thanks,
